hooks.command: [ -f fakto.config.json ] && [ -z "$FAKTO_CANVAS_RUN" ] && { if [ -x node_modules/.bin/fakto ]; then node_modules/.bin/fakto skills --quiet; echo 'This is a Fakto repo. Before anything else, use the fakto-canvas skill: start the canvas (npx fakto canvas --background) and tell the user where it runs.'; else echo 'This is a Fakto repo whose dependencies are not installed yet. Before anything else run npm install: it installs Fakto and refreshes its Claude skills in .claude/skills. Then use the fakto-canvas skill to start the canvas and tell the user where it runs.'; fi; } || true
